rows: 1. R-1 How do operators enter the hours? Decided: One positive whole-hour variable per priority. Otherwise: A JSON setting updates all priorities as one value.
2. R-2 Does the exact deadline count as overdue? Decided: It counts once the clock is later than the deadline. Otherwise: Count the deadline instant itself as overdue.

3. R-3 How do existing files get prepared before enabling? Decided: Run one offline migration command, then enable the switch. Otherwise: Start a preparatory release that migrates its file during startup.

note.text: Nobody prepares the data file by hand. When the service starts with DUE_TIMES set to on, it gives every ticket that has no due time one, from that ticket's own creation time and priority, saves the file, and then serves. It never refuses to start because due times are missing.
